summary: Nektar Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose an underwritten public offering of 3,532,609 shares (plus 529,891 option shares exercised) at $92.00 per share, expected to close April 23, 2026. Jefferies, TD Securities, and Piper Sandler are underwriters. Net proceeds estimated at $350.9 million. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing S-3ASR registration statement, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other event-driven scenario is present. The filing is a routine capital raise without additional corporate action.
